questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: If the ratio of the two roots of $\mathrm{px}^{2}+\mathrm{qx}+\mathrm{r}=0$ is $1: 5$, then show that, $5 \mathrm{q}^{2}=36 \mathrm{pr}$.

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: $\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{x}(\sqrt{1+x}-\sqrt{1-x})=?$

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: The points $A(5,3), B(-2,0)$ and $C(1,1)$ are on a circle. Find the distance between the center of the circle and center of gravity of the triangle $A B C$.

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: A particle is launched in a vertical plane and it strikes the ground at a horizontal distance $58.8 \mathrm{~m}$ from the point of launching with flight time $4 \mathrm{sec}$. What is the velocity of projection and its greatest elevation?

questions.text: Scenerio-1:[IMG: https://assets.chorcha.net/8vHZZTu7KaHxw4vpdgjQf.png]Scenerio-2: $P, Q, R$ are three forces and 0 is the circumcenter of the triangle $\mathrm{ABC}$.

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: Find the sum of the serics: $1+\frac{3}{4}+\frac{3.5}{4.8}+\frac{3.5 .7}{4.8 .12}+\cdots \infty$.

questions.subject: higher-math
questions.text: Two machines A and B produce bolts, but the machine A produces twice the amount that the machine $B$ produces in a given time. It is known that the machines A and B produce $2 \%$ and $1 \%$ defective bolts, respectively. On test a bolt was found defective. What is the probability that, the bolt was produced by the machine A?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: Immediately on explosion of an atom bomb, the firc ball produced have a radius of $100 \mathrm{~m}$ and a temperature of $10^{5} \mathrm{~K}$. What will be that approximate temperature of the fire ball when if expands adiabatically to $1000 \mathrm{~m}$ radius? (Ratio specific heats, $\frac{\mathrm{C}_{\mathrm{p}}}{\mathrm{C}_{\mathrm{v}}}=1.66$ ).

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: 2 litre water in a $1.5 \mathrm{~kW}$ electric kettle starts boiling after $6 \mathrm{~min} 20 \mathrm{sec}$. What was the initial temperature of water in the kettle? How many units of electricity were consumed to boil the water in the kettle? (Neglect heat losses).

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: $2 \mu f$ capacitor was charged and then discharged by a conducting wire. If the heat energy of 214.3 cal that was expended in heating the wire was the total energy stored in the capacitor, then what was the amount of voltage required to charge the capacitor?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: Two small equal and unlike charges $4.0 \times 10^{-8} \mathrm{C}$ are placed at $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{B}$ at a distance of $6.0 \mathrm{~cm}$. Calculate the force on the charge $1.0 \times 10^{-8} \mathrm{C}$ placed at $p$, where $p$ is $4.0 \mathrm{~cm}$ away on the perpendicular bisector of AB. $\left[\frac{1}{4 \pi \epsilon_{\theta}}=9 \times 10^{9} \mathrm{Nm}^{2} \mathrm{c}^{-2}\right]$.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: In Young's two-crack test, the distance between the cracks is 2.0 mm. Find the wavelength of the light if the distance between the stripes is 0.295 mm above the screen at a distance of 1 m from this point.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text:
[IMG: https://assets.chorcha.net/DXRri2L6iBHdbfEb3-Lgp.png]
In the figure $A$ and $B$ are two metallic plate. Work function of the two plates are $W_{A}$ and $W_{B}$ respectively $2.1 \mathrm{~V}$ and $2.0 \mathrm{eV}$. From a light source a ray of light is incident on the plate having wave length $6800 \mathrm{~A}^{\circ}$ and $5500 \mathrm{~A}^{\circ}$ respectively.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: The half-life of radioactive radon is 3.8 days. How long will it take for 30% of the original atomic number to decay?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: The length of a runway is $100 \mathrm{~m}$. An acro-plane requires a velocity of $216 \mathrm{~km} / \mathrm{hr}$ to take off. If the acceleration of the aero-plane is $15 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{sec}^{2}$, will it be possible for the acro-plane to take off from this runway? What should be the minimum length of the runway to take off?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: The stationary wave in a string created by superposition of two waves is given by the equation $y=$ $\sin \frac{\pi x}{3} \cos 40 \pi t$, where $x$ and $y$ are in centimetre and $t$ is in second. (a) What are the amplitude and velocity of the two waves? (b) What is the distance between two consecutive nodes?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A steel bar of cross-sectional area $2.0 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$ is heated to $100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ and cooled to $10^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. A compressive force develops in the bar during cooling. If the coefficient of expansion of steel is $12 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$ and Young's modulus is $2 \times 10^{11} \mathrm{Nm}^{-2}$, find the value of compressive force.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: Two aqueous solutions are prepared separately by dissolving $20.0 ~\mathrm{~g} ~\mathrm{NaOH}$ in $90.0 \mathrm{~g}$ water and $18.25 \mathrm{~g}$ $\mathrm{HCL}$ in $81.0 \mathrm{~g}$ water. The two solutions are then mixed together. The mixture is then dried by applying heat. It took 10.0 hours to dry it completely. Calculate the amount of salt obtained after drying and the number of water molecules evaporated per second during drying.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text:
(a)In an electrode, an aqueous solution of $\mathrm{HCl}$ of concentration $0.2 \mathrm{~mol} / \mathrm{dm}^{3}$ is used. Calculate the oxidation potential of the electrode at $27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$.
(b) Which of $\mathrm{HNO}_{3}$ and $\mathrm{H}_{3} \mathrm{PO}_{4}$ is stronger? Justify your answer.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: The effect of temperature on reaction rate can be expressed by $K=A e^{-E_{a} / R T}$. Here $K$ is the rate constant and $\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{a}}$ is activation energy. The rate constant, K is $0.237 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~L} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ and $2.64 \times$ $10^{-4} \mathrm{~L} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ at $25^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Calculate the activation energy.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: $2 \mathrm{FeCl}_{3}+\mathrm{SnCl}_{2}=2 \mathrm{FeCl}_{2}+\mathrm{SnCl}_{4}$ is an oxidation-reduction reaction. Show the conversion of oxidation and reduction parts separately. Explain those two conversions according to the modern concept.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: On analyzing $10 \mathrm{~g}$ of a polluted water sample, $10 \mathrm{mg}$ of impurity is found. How many pure water molecules are present in the sample?

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text:
Find out the $\mathrm{pH}$ values at the following different stages of the titration of $25 \mathrm{~mL} ~0.1 ~\mathrm{M}~ \mathrm{HCl}$ solution by $0.1 ~\mathrm{M}~ \mathrm{NaOH}$ solution.
(a) adding $24.99 \mathrm{~mL}$ of $\mathrm{NaOH}$.
(b) adding $25.1 \mathrm{~mL}$ of $\mathrm{NaOH}$.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: At constant temperature and $1 \mathrm{~atm}$ pressure, the volume of oxygen gas mixed with dust particles is 100 $\mathrm{mL}$. If pressure is increased by $75 \%$ keeping the temperature unchanged, then the volume of oxygen mixed with dust reduces to $65 \mathrm{~mL}$. What is the volume of dust particles?

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text:
A sample of $0.14 \mathrm{~g}$ of impure iron was dissolved in dilute sulphury acid. The resulting solution reacted with $20 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}$ of 0.02 moldm $^{-3} \mathrm{~K}_{2} \mathrm{Cr}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{7}$ solution.
(a) Write a balanced ionic equation for the reaction between $\mathrm{Fe}^{2+}$ ions and $\mathrm{Cr}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{7}^{2-}$ ions.
(b) Calculator the percentage of iron by mass in impure Iron sample [Atomic mass of $\mathrm{Fe}=56$ ]

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: The relative mass of the particle of $\beta$-ray is zero. When the emission of $\beta$-ray from an element takes place, the atomic number of the element increases by one unit but its atomic mass remains the same, how is it possible?

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text:
(a) In which cases of organic compound isomer is not possible?
(b) In which type of organic compounds geometrical isomers are not possible?
(c) In which class of organic compound optical isomer is possible?
